QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_65

question.text: A Benchmarking Agency can be notified by any AIF association representing at LEAST what share of AIFs?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 6.3, an association representing at least 33% of AIFs may notify Benchmarking Agencies. **The Trap:** 10/25/51% thresholds are not the prescribed level. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same 33% rule for SEBI-endorsed valuation guidelines (Ch 5). **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Today three agencies (CRISIL, NSE, Preqin) notified by IVCA serve this function.
